source_note: Source discovery from Gaia 2026 promotional trailer; primary and independent sources are recorded separately.

claims.claim: Nikola Tesla constructed and attempted a wireless power and communication project at Wardenclyffe.
claims.technical_proof: Not proof of operational global energy transfer.
claims.next_step: Identify original patents and design details; isolate experimentally tractable mechanism.

claims.claim: A modern resonant system transferred 60 watts over more than two meters at approximately 40 percent transfer efficiency.
claims.technical_proof: Published MIT/Science research; distinguish transfer-stage efficiency from whole-system wall-to-load.
claims.next_step: Define instrumented low-voltage coupling benchmark and efficiency accounting.

claims.claim: John Worrell Keely discovered an etheric force powering his motor without conventional input.
claims.technical_proof: Hidden compressed-air supply documented after dismantling apparatus; do not frame as a validated mechanism.
claims.next_step: Document hidden-input and measurement controls as an adverse example.

claims.claim: Broad frequency-based devices can heal serious diseases without conventional treatment.
claims.technical_proof: No specific device, dose, indication or clinical trial identified by this trailer; no therapeutic inference is justified.
claims.next_step: Specify each exact claimed treatment before a systematic clinical-evidence review; no human testing.

claims.claim: Alleged antigravity or overunity devices constitute replicable engineered systems.
claims.technical_proof: Promotional claims do not supply input/output measurements, calibrated instruments or reproducible schematics.
claims.next_step: Identify primary patent/document and independent proof, or hold with no prototype.
